plugin.name: GWT
plugin.description: Google Web Toolkit support for IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate, rebuilt from the JetBrains obsolete-plugins sources after the plugin was removed from JetBrains Marketplace.
plugin.change-notes:
• Built against IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 (263)
  • Fixed API usages reported by Plugin Verifier for 2026.3

plugin.name: Resource Bundle Editor
plugin.description: Editor for Java resource bundles (sets of .properties files) for IntelliJ IDEA, rebuilt from the JetBrains obsolete-plugins sources.
plugin.change-notes:
• Built against IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 (263)
  • Fixed lost and misdirected edits
  • Fixed threading errors
  • The order of keys is now computed in the background, keeping the UI responsive (IDEA-395129)
  • Undo now reverts unsaved and saved edits immediately and in editing order (IDEA-395149)
  • Pending edits are now written when documents are saved (IDEA-395112)
  • The edited property now stays selected when undoing a saved edit (IDEA-395212)
